entries.what_advanced: Nine ToT voters and three directory replicas execute as independent OS processes with independent SQLite files and TCP sockets.
entries.what_remains_unproven: Safety/liveness across separate physical hosts, regions, kernels and failure domains.
entries.why_it_remains_unproven: Every final test runs on one host and loopback network; SQLite persistence is local.
entries.why_the_why_remains_unaddressed: The work closed process separation first because no authenticated multi-host transport/storage substrate is presently bound to these replicas.
entries.why_the_unaddressed_condition_remains: Without a host-to-host transport and deployment plane, moving processes onto separate machines would be an unqualified hosting change rather than a tested architecture.
entries.missing_architecture_required: Multi-host peer transport; node discovery; per-host durable store; network-fault harness; clocks/timers policy; deployment topology; host identity; remote restart/rejoin; cross-host evidence collector.
entries.promotion_evidence_required: At least 3 independent hosts across >=2 failure domains; real partitions/asymmetric loss/process pause/restart; no incompatible committed roots; recovery receipts from each host.

entries.what_advanced: Terms, elections, log append/commit, quorum certificates, conflict fencing, crash/rejoin and higher-term uncommitted supersession execute over nine voter processes.
entries.what_remains_unproven: Peers do not autonomously discover/elect/replicate without ProcessCluster acting as the external protocol driver.
entries.why_it_remains_unproven: ProcessCluster constructs certificates, schedules RPC phases and decides transitions.
entries.why_the_why_remains_unaddressed: Replacing the coordinator requires a peer protocol with timeouts, leader state, replication progress and recovery rules; none of those can be inferred from the current client harness.
entries.why_the_unaddressed_condition_remains: The present layer was intentionally bounded to make distributed effects falsifiable before claiming a complete consensus algorithm.
entries.missing_architecture_required: Peer-resident election timers; leader/follower state machine; nextIndex/matchIndex or equivalent progress; heartbeats; retransmission/backoff; conflict repair; durable election state; formal safety specification/model checking.
entries.promotion_evidence_required: Cluster starts with no external coordinator and reaches one leader; concurrent candidates/partitions/restarts never create incompatible commits; model checking plus destructive tests.

entries.what_advanced: Known replicas can restart stale, catch up and rejoin while preserving roots.
entries.why_it_remains_unproven: VOTERS and directory replica IDs are static constants; no membership log exists.
entries.why_the_why_remains_unaddressed: Membership changes alter quorum intersection and cannot be safely represented as a normal metadata update.
entries.why_the_unaddressed_condition_remains: No joint configuration/learner state has yet been engineered or persisted.
entries.missing_architecture_required: Committed membership configuration history; non-voting learner; catch-up threshold; explicit promotion; overlapping/joint quorum transition; removal fence; identity rejoin/replacement law.
entries.promotion_evidence_required: Property/model tests over add/remove during partitions plus multi-process destructive runs proving quorum intersection across every configuration transition.

entries.what_advanced: Logical voter IDs and semantic authority are explicit and receipts are hash-linked.
entries.what_remains_unproven: A received vote/RPC is not cryptographically proven to originate from the named workload.
entries.why_it_remains_unproven: Transport is plaintext loopback TCP and voter names are configuration strings.
entries.why_the_why_remains_unaddressed: No certificate/trust-domain/key lifecycle is attached to the process identities.
entries.why_the_unaddressed_condition_remains: Identity work was deliberately not faked by embedding static secrets or labels into receipts.
entries.missing_architecture_required: mTLS TLS 1.3 profile; workload attestation/SPIFFE-like identity plane; trust bundles; short-lived credentials; key rotation/revocation; signed vote/session binding; authorization policy.
entries.promotion_evidence_required: Forged peer and replay tests fail; rotated/revoked credentials behave correctly; each commit certificate links to independently verifiable authenticated sessions.

entries.what_advanced: One Python canonical profile deterministically hashes resident semantic records and committed state.
entries.what_remains_unproven: The same semantic object produces the same cryptographic identity across compliant non-Python implementations.
entries.why_it_remains_unproven: Observed RFC8785 probe differs for 1e-7 between Python profile and ECMAScript serialization.
entries.why_the_why_remains_unaddressed: Canonicalization is currently an implementation helper rather than a normative cross-language protocol.
entries.why_the_unaddressed_condition_remains: Earlier work optimized deterministic local evidence before defining an interoperable canonical wire identity.
entries.missing_architecture_required: Normative JCS implementation or deterministic CBOR profile; language-independent test vectors; numeric/unicode edge cases; versioned canonicalization identifier in hashes/receipts.
entries.promotion_evidence_required: Independent Python/JS/Rust/Go implementations produce byte-identical canonical vectors and roots for the complete corpus edge-case suite.

entries.what_advanced: Resident lookup uses exact source entities plus casefold; original provenance is preserved.
entries.what_remains_unproven: Canonical-equivalent Unicode spellings resolve to one intended semantic identity across languages.
entries.why_it_remains_unproven: No Unicode normalization form is applied before lookup or semantic hashing.
entries.why_the_why_remains_unaddressed: Normalization can change semantics in some domains, so choosing NFC/NFKC cannot be guessed globally.
entries.why_the_unaddressed_condition_remains: The recovered lexicon is predominantly English and does not supply a full multilingual normalization policy.
entries.missing_architecture_required: Per-domain normalization policy; UAX #15 implementation; original-form provenance; normalized lookup key; multilingual collision/confusable tests; script-specific exceptions.
entries.promotion_evidence_required: NFC/NFD/NFKC vectors across supported languages resolve according to declared policy without unintended identity collapse.

entries.what_advanced: The integrated translator reads 1084 recovered lexicon entries, 71 router entries, 7 translator domains and 11 runtime registers; KEX-L-TRANS is actually observed.
entries.what_remains_unproven: This adapter is not the complete IL-LLM runtime/dictionary/grammar corpus.
entries.why_it_remains_unproven: It is a read-only adapter over recovered workbook surfaces and two lexicon entries are degraded.
entries.why_the_why_remains_unaddressed: The full authoritative grammar/dictionary execution surface has not been identified as one complete, versioned, executable source.
entries.why_the_unaddressed_condition_remains: Merging incomplete workbook fragments would fabricate authority and erase source defects.
entries.missing_architecture_required: Versioned IL-LLM corpus manifest; complete grammar/rule tables; multilingual dictionaries/thesauri; source repair workflow; provenance per entry; deterministic compiler from corpus to runtime index; corpus validation.
entries.promotion_evidence_required: Complete corpus inventory and hashes; zero unresolved/degraded required entries; grammar test suite; rebuild from corpus to runtime producing identical semantic index.

entries.deficiency: Full semantic binding in binary packet
entries.what_advanced: KXBD packet binds an 8-byte prefix of semantic_digest and a full payload SHA-256; wrong digest prefix is rejected.
entries.what_remains_unproven: The packet itself does not carry or authenticate the full 256-bit semantic digest.
entries.why_it_remains_unproven: Header currently stores only the first 8 bytes to keep fixed metadata compact.
entries.why_the_why_remains_unaddressed: There is no signed external semantic-reference object that upgrades the prefix into full authenticated identity.
entries.why_the_unaddressed_condition_remains: The boundary was designed to prove separation of semantic identity from byte representation, not to define the final security protocol.
entries.missing_architecture_required: Full semantic digest or collision-resistant content-address reference in packet; versioned schema; optional signature/MAC bound to full semantic digest + payload digest + codec profile.
entries.promotion_evidence_required: Collision/adversarial corpus tests and cryptographic verification prove a packet cannot be rebound to a different accepted semantic object.

entries.what_advanced: A/B and RAW adaptive binary lowering is reversible, deterministic for tested inputs and integrity checked.
entries.what_remains_unproven: Interoperability with standard binary serialization ecosystems.
entries.why_it_remains_unproven: KXBD is a private codec and is not CBOR/Protobuf/ASN.1/etc.
entries.why_the_why_remains_unaddressed: A/B expresses bit runs, not a general semantic data model with standard schema evolution.
entries.why_the_unaddressed_condition_remains: The custom codec is intentionally a KEX boundary experiment, and universal compression was falsified.
entries.missing_architecture_required: Formal KXBD specification/test vectors and/or deterministic CBOR profile; schema/version negotiation; extensibility; independent decoder implementation; resource limits.
entries.promotion_evidence_required: Independent implementation decodes/encodes all normative vectors; malformed/fuzzed packets fail safely; semantic roots match across implementations.

entries.what_advanced: HTML concept projection contains escaped human-readable meaning and private data-* identity metadata; Layer-2 repairs drift.
entries.what_remains_unproven: Generic third-party software can interpret KEX semantic metadata without project knowledge.
entries.why_it_remains_unproven: WHATWG data-* is application-private metadata, not a generic vocabulary.
entries.why_the_why_remains_unaddressed: No public vocabulary/namespace/schema has been standardized for KEX semantic concepts.
entries.why_the_unaddressed_condition_remains: Publishing internal data-* names as if they were universal semantics would repeat the exact presentation/authority conflation this work is avoiding.
entries.missing_architecture_required: External semantic vocabulary/profile if needed; schema identifiers; version negotiation; mapping from IL-LLM semantic records to standardized machine-readable representation; conformance validator.
entries.promotion_evidence_required: Independent consumer correctly interprets semantic objects without KEX source-code knowledge and without relying on visual layout.

entries.what_advanced: 13 persisted databases pass integrity_check and run WAL + synchronous FULL; atomic file actuator uses fsync + os.replace + directory fsync.
entries.what_remains_unproven: Survival of actual machine power loss, filesystem/kernel crash, disk-full/torn-write/controller failure.
entries.why_it_remains_unproven: Tests terminate processes and modify databases, not electrical/storage hardware.
entries.why_the_why_remains_unaddressed: A process crash cannot reproduce every storage-controller and filesystem failure mode.
entries.why_the_unaddressed_condition_remains: No destructive hardware/VM power-cut harness with storage-level telemetry has been connected.
entries.missing_architecture_required: Power-cut VM or hardware test rig; filesystem matrix; disk-full/fault injection; WAL/checkpoint policy; backup/restore; torn-write corruption corpus; durability SLA.
entries.promotion_evidence_required: Repeated cut-at-every-transition campaigns recover to either prior or committed valid state with no silent accepted-root divergence.

entries.what_advanced: Three independent directory processes persist and converge from the canonical committed log; one was killed stale, restarted, and caught up.
entries.what_remains_unproven: Directory replicas autonomously subscribe to accepted commits and repair gaps without an external sync() call.
entries.why_it_remains_unproven: DirectoryCluster explicitly pushes the canonical log to replicas.
entries.why_the_why_remains_unaddressed: There is no commit-stream subscription/watch protocol or per-replica replication cursor negotiated between peers.
entries.why_the_unaddressed_condition_remains: The current design proved authority projection and rejoin before adding another distributed transport.
entries.missing_architecture_required: Authenticated commit stream; durable applied cursor; snapshot bootstrap; gap request/repair; backpressure; stale-replica fencing; root gossip/comparison; automatic resubscription.
entries.promotion_evidence_required: Kill/restart/partition replicas without calling sync(); replicas autonomously catch up and converge with bounded recovery evidence.

entries.what_advanced: Closed-loop reconciler performs actual atomic filesystem effects, idempotency receipts, readback, drift detection/repair and stale accepted-state fencing.
entries.what_remains_unproven: Real DNS/TLS/compute/container/device/provider manifestations converge under partial external failures.
entries.why_it_remains_unproven: Only a local managed filesystem actuator is bound in R5.
entries.why_the_why_remains_unaddressed: Each real target has different create/update/delete semantics, idempotency, eventual consistency and rollback constraints.
entries.why_the_unaddressed_condition_remains: Inventing one generic actuator would falsely claim control over systems not connected to the test environment.
entries.missing_architecture_required: Typed actuator interface; target-specific adapters; observers; retry/backoff; timeout/cancel; idempotency keys; compensation semantics; per-target credentials/policies; status feedback.
entries.promotion_evidence_required: Closed-loop destructive staging tests against each real target with induced timeouts/partial failures and verified convergence/readback.

entries.what_advanced: Semantic owner, KEX route, source locator/status and accepted digest are explicit and fail-closed on mismatch.
entries.what_remains_unproven: Who is authorized to create/change a semantic definition or promote a repaired degraded source is not cryptographically enforced.
entries.why_it_remains_unproven: Authority is represented as metadata and trusted source files, not an authorization decision with principals and signed policy.
entries.why_the_why_remains_unaddressed: The present work verifies consistency of supplied semantics, not governance of who may redefine them.
entries.why_the_unaddressed_condition_remains: No capability lease/policy engine/signature chain is connected to IL-LLM mutation or KEX commit admission.
entries.missing_architecture_required: Principal identity; signed semantic revisions; capability/policy engine; review/promotion states; revocation; immutable audit chain; quorum policy for semantic schema changes.
entries.promotion_evidence_required: Unauthorized mutation/replay/rollback fails; authorized revision creates traceable new semantic version without rewriting prior history.

entries.what_advanced: Crash, omission, stale state, tamper detection and minority-quorum failures are tested.
entries.what_remains_unproven: Safety with arbitrary malicious replicas sending equivocal or forged protocol messages.
entries.why_it_remains_unproven: Quorum arithmetic assumes crash/omission behavior and trusted process identities.
entries.why_the_why_remains_unaddressed: Byzantine tolerance requires a different threat model, quorum mathematics and authenticated message protocol.
entries.why_the_unaddressed_condition_remains: No BFT protocol was requested or honestly implemented; labeling current majority behavior BFT would be false.
entries.missing_architecture_required: Explicit BFT decision; authenticated signed messages; 3f+1-style or selected protocol constraints; equivocation evidence; view change; state transfer; formal proof/model; adversarial network tests.
entries.promotion_evidence_required: Byzantine test harness with malicious peers cannot create conflicting commits within the stated fault threshold; proof assumptions are documented and checked.
